summary: Complete hyperMILL Training Manual AI integration with 64 new domains across 8 categories: Training Day 1 (8 domains for 2D/CAD basics), Training Day 2 (8 domains for 3D machining/mold/MAXX), Training Day 3 (8 domains for advanced 2D/drilling/pockets), hyperCAD-S (8 domains for sketch/surface/solid modeling), Automation Center (8 domains for batch/scheduling/workflow), Virtual Machining Center (8 domains for simulation/collision/verification), Tool Builder (8 domains for tool definition/geometry/cutting data), SQL Database (8 domains for tool/macro/material databases). Leverages 998 PDFs, Training Day 1-3 folders, all hyperMILL manuals. 132 tests passing. Ready for PRISM CLI integration.
